import csv, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rows = list(csv.reader(open('storage/shared/atlas/overlays/stability_refit.csv')))[1:]
w = [float(r[0]) for r in rows]
ethos_delta = [float(r[2]) for r in rows]
stability = [float(r[3]) for r in rows]
entropy = [float(r[4]) for r in rows]
zephyr_flux = [e * 0.5 for e in entropy]  # Proxy from #18 departure
plt.scatter(w, ethos_delta, c=stability, s=[100*(1-e)*f for e,f in zip(entropy, zephyr_flux)], cmap='viridis')
for regime in [3.25, 3.0, 6.0]: plt.axvline(regime, color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'Regime {regime}')
plt.xlabel('w'); plt.ylabel('ethos_delta'); plt.colorbar(label='stability'); plt.legend()
plt.savefig('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/zephyr_integrated_panel.png')
print('Zephyr-integrated panel generated.')
